figures.caption: Wiring Schematic (rotated 90° on page)
figures.what_it_shows: VERIFIED via vision: hybrid schematic, power section component-level, control section block-level. Power path: AC input (K1, AC1/AC2/G, 120-240V/50/60Hz) → rectifier bridges → PFC (with IGBT) → DC bus → IGBT inverter (2 half-bridge pairs) → transformer T1 (T60*30*28) → secondary rectifier diodes → OUT+ (through Hall current sensor)/OUT-. Control path: 24V aux → CN5 (up to pin 34) → MCU BOARD → CN6 (4-pin) → LCD SCREEN; MCU also drives CN7/CN8/CN3/CN4 → FAST WIRE FEED SWITCH, 2x SOLENOID VALVE, WIRE FEEDER motor; REMOTE BOARD (CN1/CN2/CN3) → 2x AVIATION PLUG connectors; FAN/FAN2 (2-pin each) → cooling fans.
